samples.title: Điện thoại trong lớp
samples.prompt: Your friend is interested in smartphones in the classroom but does not know where to begin. Write an email giving practical advice, explaining a possible difficulty, and offering help.
requirementsVi: Cho bước bắt đầu cụ thể.
Giải thích một khó khăn và cách xử lý.
Đề nghị hỗ trợ thực tế.
samples.summaryVi: Điện thoại có ích khi có nhiệm vụ rõ; thông báo và luật dùng không rõ dễ gây xao nhãng.

paragraphs.label: Mở thư
paragraphs.text:
Hi Alex,

Thanks for telling me about your interest in smartphones in the classroom. I understand why you are unsure where to start. You do not need a perfect plan immediately, but a few practical steps could make things easier.
paragraphs.noteVi: Đồng cảm, xác định mục đích khuyên.

paragraphs.label: Lời khuyên đầu
paragraphs.text: First, I suggest joining a digital learning workshop at the community centre on Saturday at nine in the morning. There, we can try a phone-based research task and discuss classroom rules. One useful point is that students can quickly access useful learning material. For example, a class can compare two digital maps to explain how a neighbourhood has changed.
paragraphs.noteVi: Gợi ý hoạt động có ngày, nơi và lý do.

paragraphs.label: Khó khăn và cách xử lý
paragraphs.text: One thing to remember is that notifications can distract students. This can happen because phone rules are sometimes unclear or applied differently in each lesson. A useful response would be to agree on specific times for phone use and keep devices away during other tasks. For instance, a teacher could allow phones for a five-minute research task and then ask students to put them in their bags. Try the idea on a small scale before deciding whether to continue.
paragraphs.noteVi: Nêu giới hạn để lời khuyên không tuyệt đối.

paragraphs.label: Đề nghị và kết
paragraphs.text:
If you like, I can come with you and help you write down the most useful points. Afterwards, we could make a simple plan together.

Please let me know what you think when you have a moment. I would be happy to answer any other questions.

Best wishes,
Minh
